scope: Opt-in isolated native classroom PHP/PDO HTTP lifecycle with one synthetic teacher and narrow cookie student capabilities

checks.name: one synthetic teacher account created only after isolated schema, port and cookie guards
teacher actions require authentication, CSRF and matching owner; private code contains 128 random bits
guest student capability is idempotent, cannot silently orphan an alias, and grants no account identity
an independent real SQL member lock fences assignment reads; join resumes after release without duplicating an assignment
sharing requires capability and explicit consent; altered assignment is rejected, canonical replay is accepted once and conflicting evidence is rejected
teacher receives exact weighted aggregate facts without code, email, passage or keystroke logs; next assignment receives a new identity
student leave deletes membership and aggregate receipts and revokes the narrow capability
authenticated students can join and leave without resetting general account authentication
explicit class deletion and owned teacher-account deletion cascade only the synthetic classroom data
